specifications.title: Engine oil
specifications.value: 0W-20 synthetic · API SN Resource Conserving or ILSAC GF-5
specifications.notes: These are the manual’s original oil requirements, not a claim that a newer specification is incompatible. Subaru-approved oil is preferred.

specifications.title: Oil & filter change
specifications.notes: Guideline for an oil-and-filter change. Verify the dipstick level after refilling; not total engine dry capacity.

specifications.title: Engine coolant
specifications.value: SUBARU Super Coolant · 8.2 US qt / 7.8 L system capacity
specifications.notes: 2.5 L CVT system quantity, not a measured drain-and-fill amount. The 2017 warranty booklet note 10 specifies Subaru cooling system conditioner when replacing coolant.

specifications.title: Front differential
specifications.value: SUBARU Extra MT; API GL-5 75W-90 alternative · 1.3 US qt / 1.2 L guideline
specifications.notes: The manual lists Extra MT as factory fill. Its GL-5 alternative may reduce drivability or fuel economy. Confirm the fill level by the specified service procedure.

specifications.title: Rear differential
specifications.value: API GL-5 · 75W-90 recommended · 0.8 US qt / 0.8 L guideline
specifications.notes: The manual also lists SAE 90 for the indicated temperature range. Check the specified level; printed units are manufacturer-rounded.

specifications.title: CVT
specifications.value: 12.0 US qt · 11.4 L published capacity; fluid type: consult Subaru
specifications.notes: This is a published transmission capacity, NOT a normal drain-and-fill quantity. Correct service fluid and procedure require exact transmission/VIN verification.

specifications.title: Brake fluid
specifications.notes: The manual provides no refill volume. Use new fluid from a sealed container; follow the brake-service procedure.

specifications.title: Spark plugs
specifications.notes: Type listed for the 2.5 L engine. Do not infer a tightening torque or electrode adjustment from this reference.

specifications.title: Battery
specifications.notes: Manual battery type, not an aftermarket group-size or CCA fitment claim. Check polarity, dimensions, hold-down and current replacement fitment.

specifications.title: Factory 17-inch tires
specifications.notes: Applies to the manual’s Legacy 17-inch tire configuration. The actual vehicle door placard governs; changed wheels or load ratings need verification.

specifications.title: Wheel nuts
specifications.notes: Use the manual’s wheel installation procedure and have the tightening torque checked by an automotive service facility after owner installation.

specifications.title: Fuel
specifications.value: 87 AKI / 90 RON minimum · 18.5 US gal / 70 L tank
specifications.notes: Unleaded gasoline; tank capacity is not a fill-up target.

parts.title: Spark-plug type
parts.notes: Manufacturer-listed spark-plug type; no OEM order number is inferred.

parts.title: Oil-filter bulletin
parts.status: Bulletin reference; exact fitment requires verification
parts.notes: The bulletin lists new filters alongside earlier 15208AA15A and 15208AA12A filters. It does not establish the exact VIN-specific pairing here. Do not select either new filter solely from this general reference.

parts.title: Other filters & CVT service fluid
parts.value: Not yet verified for exact VIN
parts.notes: Engine air filter, cabin filter, oil-filter VIN pairing and CVT service fluid require Subaru catalog/service confirmation. Save known installed part numbers in your service record.
